annotations.text:
OPTION A · One Scroll
Everything on a single screen: player, stats, rehearsal script, journal, AI review.

Why: matches the ask most literally. Zero navigation.
Tradeoff: a long page. The script and journal live below the fold, so rehearsal before sitting means scrolling past the player.

OPTION B · Two Tabs
Practice = script up top, player docked at the bottom. Progress = stats ring, AI read, session log.

Why: the rehearse-then-play ritual is one screen with nothing else in the way, and the reflective stuff gets room to breathe.
Tradeoff: two places to look. Stats are not on the screen you meditate from.

OPTION C · Focus
A big dial you press to start. Stats are one quiet line at the top. The script is a sheet you pull up from the bottom, and rating plus notes slide up automatically when the track ends.

Why: calmest to sit in front of; the moment of play is the whole screen.
Tradeoff: script and journal are one gesture away rather than visible, and editing the script happens inside the sheet.

Shared across all three
· Music is picked from the Files app via the folder button (iOS file picker, then cached in the app).
· The rate-and-notes sheet (see C · After session) appears after any session in every option.
· Two accounts: the avatar initial in the header switches or signs in the second user.
· Look: midnight indigo, gold light, Cormorant Garamond display with Manrope body. Original palette in the spirit of the Dispenza aesthetic, not his branding.
